players.label: Player entities
players.description:
Specify which HA media_player entity id's you like to import as players in Music Assistant.

Note that only Media player entities will be listed which are compatible with Music Assistant.

warn_hass_integration.label: Music Assistant has native support for this player type - it is strongly recommended to use the native player provider for this player in Music Assistant instead of the generic version provided by the Home Assistant provider.

manifest.description: Control and play music on (supported) Home Assistant media players in your smart home.
